-- Every bronze row mapped to the canonical contract (ADR-005), with a reject reason (NULL = valid)
-- and a duplicate rank among valid rows. Downstream reads stg_meter__readings / _quarantine.

with bronze as (
    select
        raw_payload,
        is_valid_json,
        schema_version,
        meter_id,
        source_file,
        line_no,
        file_arrival_ts,
        ingested_at,
        dt as landing_date_ist,
        zone as gateway_zone
    from read_parquet(
        'data/lake/bronze/*/*/*.parquet',
        hive_partitioning = true,
        hive_types = {'dt': date, 'zone': varchar}
    )
),

v1 as (
    select
        *,
        json_extract_string(raw_payload, '$.ts') as source_ts_text,
        try_cast(json_extract_string(raw_payload, '$.energy_wh') as decimal(18, 4)) as source_energy,
        'Wh' as source_unit,
        json_extract_string(raw_payload, '$.status') as status,
        null::decimal(6, 1) as voltage_v,
        null::varchar as firmware_version
    from bronze
    where schema_version = 1
),

v2 as (
    select
        *,
        json_extract_string(raw_payload, '$.ts') as source_ts_text,
        try_cast(json_extract_string(raw_payload, '$.energy') as decimal(18, 4)) as source_energy,
        json_extract_string(raw_payload, '$.unit') as source_unit,
        json_extract_string(raw_payload, '$.status') as status,
        try_cast(json_extract_string(raw_payload, '$.voltage') as decimal(6, 1)) as voltage_v,
        json_extract_string(raw_payload, '$.firmware_version') as firmware_version
    from bronze
    where schema_version = 2
),

unhandled as (
    select *
    from bronze
    where schema_version is null or schema_version not in (1, 2)
),

unioned as (
    select * from v1
    union all by name
    select * from v2
    union all by name
    select * from unhandled
),

parsed as (
    select
        *,
        case
            when regexp_matches(source_ts_text, '([+-]\d{2}:\d{2}|Z)$')
                then try_cast(source_ts_text as timestamptz)
            -- naive timestamps are IST (CLAUDE.md time-zone rule)
            else timezone('Asia/Kolkata', try_cast(source_ts_text as timestamp))
        end as source_reading_ts,
        case source_unit
            when 'Wh' then source_energy * 0.001
            when 'kWh' then source_energy
        end::decimal(18, 4) as register_kwh
    from unioned
),

snapped as (
    select
        *,
        -- signed distance (s) to the nearest 15-min grid point; IST offset is a multiple of 15 min
        case
            when epoch(source_reading_ts)::bigint % 900 <= 450
                then epoch(source_reading_ts)::bigint % 900
            else epoch(source_reading_ts)::bigint % 900 - 900
        end as snap_seconds
    from parsed
),

checked as (
    select
        s.*,
        s.source_reading_ts - to_seconds(s.snap_seconds) as reading_ts,
        m.feeder_id,
        m.zone_id,
        case
            when not s.is_valid_json then 'invalid_json'
            when s.schema_version is null or s.schema_version not in (1, 2) then 'unknown_schema'
            when s.meter_id is null or s.source_reading_ts is null or s.source_energy is null
                then 'missing_or_unparseable_field'
            when s.source_unit is null or s.source_unit not in ('Wh', 'kWh') then 'unknown_unit'
            when s.source_energy < 0 then 'negative_energy'
            when abs(s.snap_seconds) > 120 then 'off_grid'
            when m.meter_id is null then 'unknown_meter'
        end as reject_reason
    from snapped as s
    left join "gridpulse"."main"."meter_master" as m on s.meter_id = m.meter_id
)

select
    meter_id,
    feeder_id,
    zone_id,
    reading_ts,
    reading_ts - interval '15 minutes' as interval_start_ts,
    cast(
        timezone('Asia/Kolkata', reading_ts - interval '15 minutes')
        as date
    ) as interval_date_ist,
    register_kwh,
    status,
    voltage_v,
    firmware_version,
    schema_version,
    source_reading_ts,
    source_energy,
    source_unit,
    snap_seconds,
    reject_reason,
    case
        when reject_reason is null
            then row_number() over (
                partition by reject_reason is null, meter_id, reading_ts
                order by ingested_at, file_arrival_ts, source_file, line_no
            )
    end as dup_rank,
    raw_payload,
    source_file,
    line_no,
    file_arrival_ts,
    ingested_at,
    landing_date_ist,
    gateway_zone
from checked

-- One row per meter (from the master) per 15-min grid slot in the window (FR-07, FR-21).
-- Gaps are marked, never filled. A reading after a gap carries the whole register delta once,
-- with gap_intervals = number of missing slots it spans. Window defaults: first reading's IST date
-- .. last interval date; override with --vars '{window_start: ..., window_end: ...}'.

with readings as (
    select
        r.meter_id,
        r.reading_ts,
        r.interval_start_ts,
        r.register_kwh,
        r.status,
        m.register_max_kwh
    from "gridpulse"."main_staging"."stg_meter__readings" as r
    inner join "gridpulse"."main"."meter_master" as m on r.meter_id = m.meter_id
),

bounds as (
    select
        cast(timezone('Asia/Kolkata', min(reading_ts)) as date) as start_date_ist,
        cast(timezone('Asia/Kolkata', max(interval_start_ts)) as date) as end_date_ist
    from readings
),

ordered as (
    select
        *,
        lag(register_kwh) over w as prev_register_kwh,
        lag(reading_ts) over w as prev_reading_ts
    from readings
    window w as (partition by meter_id order by reading_ts)
),

classified as (
    select
        meter_id,
        reading_ts,
        interval_start_ts,
        register_kwh,
        prev_register_kwh,
        status,
        cast((epoch(reading_ts) - epoch(prev_reading_ts)) / (15 * 60) as integer) - 1
            as gap_intervals,
        case
            when prev_register_kwh is null then null
            when register_kwh >= prev_register_kwh then register_kwh - prev_register_kwh
            -- legitimate wrap of the cumulative register
            when status = 'ROLLOVER' then (register_max_kwh - prev_register_kwh) + register_kwh
        end::decimal(18, 4) as delta_kwh,
        case
            when prev_register_kwh is null then 'no_previous_reading'
            when register_kwh < prev_register_kwh and status <> 'ROLLOVER' then 'register_decrease'
        end as dq_flag
    from ordered
),

slot_series as (
    select
        unnest(
            generate_series(
                start_date_ist::timestamp,
                end_date_ist::timestamp + interval 1 day - interval 15 minute,
                interval 15 minute
            )
        ) as slot_local
    from bounds
),

grid as (
    select
        m.meter_id,
        m.feeder_id,
        m.zone_id,
        timezone('Asia/Kolkata', s.slot_local) as interval_start_ts
    from "gridpulse"."main"."meter_master" as m
    cross join slot_series as s
)

select
    g.meter_id,
    g.feeder_id,
    g.zone_id,
    g.interval_start_ts,
    g.interval_start_ts + interval 15 minute as interval_end_ts,
    cast(timezone('Asia/Kolkata', g.interval_start_ts) as date) as interval_date_ist,
    timezone('Asia/Kolkata', date_trunc('hour', timezone('Asia/Kolkata', g.interval_start_ts)))
        as hour_start_ts,
    c.reading_ts,
    c.register_kwh,
    c.prev_register_kwh,
    c.status,
    c.reading_ts is null as is_gap,
    c.gap_intervals,
    c.delta_kwh,
    c.dq_flag
from grid as g
left join classified as c
    on g.meter_id = c.meter_id and g.interval_start_ts = c.interval_start_ts

-- NFR-11: for every meter without a register_decrease, the sum of interval deltas in the window
-- equals (last register - register before the first delta) + rollovers × register_max, exactly.
with meter_stats as (
    select
        i.meter_id,
        sum(i.delta_kwh) as sum_delta_kwh,
        arg_max(i.register_kwh, i.interval_start_ts) filter (where i.delta_kwh is not null)
            as last_register_kwh,
        arg_min(i.prev_register_kwh, i.interval_start_ts) filter (where i.delta_kwh is not null)
            as first_prev_register_kwh,
        count(*) filter (
            where i.delta_kwh is not null and i.register_kwh < i.prev_register_kwh
        ) as rollovers,
        count(*) filter (where i.dq_flag = 'register_decrease') as decreases
    from "gridpulse"."main_intermediate"."int_meter_intervals" as i
    group by i.meter_id
)

select
    s.*,
    m.register_max_kwh
from meter_stats as s
inner join "gridpulse"."main"."meter_master" as m on s.meter_id = m.meter_id
where
    s.decreases = 0
    and s.sum_delta_kwh is not null
    and s.sum_delta_kwh
    <> s.last_register_kwh - s.first_prev_register_kwh + s.rollovers * m.register_max_kwh

-- Daily kWh per meter with completeness and the DQ-4 quality flag (FR-08, FR-22).

select
    meter_id,
    feeder_id,
    zone_id,
    interval_date_ist,
    coalesce(sum(delta_kwh), 0)::decimal(18, 4) as consumption_kwh,
    count(*) as intervals_expected,
    count(reading_ts) as intervals_received,
    count(*) filter (where is_gap) as gap_intervals,
    count(*) filter (where dq_flag = 'register_decrease') as register_decrease_intervals,
    round(100.0 * count(reading_ts) / count(*), 2)::decimal(6, 2) as completeness_pct,
    case
        when count(reading_ts) < count(*) * 0.9
            then 'LOW_COMPLETENESS'
        else 'OK'
    end as quality_flag
from "gridpulse"."main_intermediate"."int_meter_intervals"
group by meter_id, feeder_id, zone_id, interval_date_ist

-- Hourly kWh per meter (FR-08). Kept in the DuckDB lake for 13 months (ADR-003), not published.
-- A delta spanning a gap is counted in the hour of the reading that closes it.

select
    meter_id,
    feeder_id,
    zone_id,
    hour_start_ts,
    interval_date_ist,
    coalesce(sum(delta_kwh), 0)::decimal(18, 4) as consumption_kwh,
    count(reading_ts) as intervals_received,
    count(*) filter (where is_gap) as gap_intervals,
    count(*) filter (where dq_flag = 'register_decrease') as register_decrease_intervals
from "gridpulse"."main_intermediate"."int_meter_intervals"
group by meter_id, feeder_id, zone_id, hour_start_ts, interval_date_ist

-- OUTAGE (FR-13): >= outage_missing_share of a feeder's master meters miss the same interval,
-- for >= outage_min_intervals consecutive intervals. One event per feeder per contiguous run.

with feeder_size as (
    select
        feeder_id,
        count(*) as meters
    from "gridpulse"."main"."meter_master"
    group by feeder_id
),

slot_missing as (
    select
        feeder_id,
        zone_id,
        interval_start_ts,
        count(*) filter (where is_gap) as missing_meters
    from "gridpulse"."main_intermediate"."int_meter_intervals"
    group by feeder_id, zone_id, interval_start_ts
),

flagged as (
    select
        s.*,
        f.meters,
        s.missing_meters / f.meters as missing_share,
        epoch(s.interval_start_ts) / (15 * 60)
        - row_number() over (partition by s.feeder_id order by s.interval_start_ts) as island
    from slot_missing as s
    inner join feeder_size as f on s.feeder_id = f.feeder_id
    where s.missing_meters >= 0.3 * f.meters
)

select
    'OUTAGE' as anomaly_type,
    null::varchar as meter_id,
    feeder_id,
    zone_id,
    min(interval_start_ts) as start_ts,
    max(interval_start_ts) + interval 15 minute as end_ts,
    count(*) as intervals,
    'max_missing_share' as metric_name,
    round(max(missing_share), 3)::decimal(12, 3) as metric_value,
    0.3::decimal(12, 3) as threshold,
    max(missing_meters) as affected_meters,
    0::decimal(18, 4) as peak_kwh
from flagged
group by feeder_id, zone_id, island
having count(*) >= 2

-- SUSPECTED TAMPER (FR-12): a meter's register is flat (0 kWh) for >= tamper_zero_intervals
-- consecutive intervals while >= tamper_peer_active_share of the other meters on its feeder
-- consumed energy in that same window. A zero delta that spans a gap counts for every slot it
-- covers (the register did not move across the gap). A whole-feeder zero period is not tamper.

with received as (
    select
        meter_id,
        feeder_id,
        zone_id,
        interval_start_ts,
        gap_intervals,
        delta_kwh = 0 as is_zero
    from "gridpulse"."main_intermediate"."int_meter_intervals"
    where delta_kwh is not null
),

runs as (
    select
        *,
        row_number() over (partition by meter_id order by interval_start_ts)
        - row_number() over (partition by meter_id, is_zero order by interval_start_ts) as run_id
    from received
),

zero_runs as (
    select
        meter_id,
        feeder_id,
        zone_id,
        min(interval_start_ts - to_minutes(15 * gap_intervals))
            as start_ts,
        max(interval_start_ts) + interval 15 minute as end_ts,
        sum(1 + gap_intervals) as zero_intervals
    from runs
    where is_zero
    group by meter_id, feeder_id, zone_id, run_id
    having sum(1 + gap_intervals) >= 192
),

feeder_size as (
    select
        feeder_id,
        count(*) as meters
    from "gridpulse"."main"."meter_master"
    group by feeder_id
),

peer_usage as (
    select
        z.meter_id,
        z.start_ts,
        i.meter_id as peer_meter_id,
        coalesce(sum(i.delta_kwh), 0) as peer_kwh
    from zero_runs as z
    inner join "gridpulse"."main_intermediate"."int_meter_intervals" as i
        on
            z.feeder_id = i.feeder_id
            and z.meter_id <> i.meter_id
            and z.start_ts <= i.interval_start_ts
            and z.end_ts > i.interval_start_ts
    group by z.meter_id, z.start_ts, i.meter_id
),

peer_share as (
    select
        meter_id,
        start_ts,
        count(*) filter (where peer_kwh > 0) as active_peers
    from peer_usage
    group by meter_id, start_ts
)

select
    'TAMPER' as anomaly_type,
    z.meter_id,
    z.feeder_id,
    z.zone_id,
    z.start_ts,
    z.end_ts,
    z.zero_intervals as intervals,
    'active_peer_share' as metric_name,
    round(p.active_peers / (f.meters - 1), 3)::decimal(12, 3) as metric_value,
    0.7::decimal(12, 3) as threshold,
    1 as affected_meters,
    0::decimal(18, 4) as peak_kwh
from zero_runs as z
inner join peer_share as p on z.meter_id = p.meter_id and z.start_ts = p.start_ts
inner join feeder_size as f on z.feeder_id = f.feeder_id
where p.active_peers >= 0.7 * (f.meters - 1)

-- SPIKE (FR-11, ADR-006): interval kWh z-score > spike_z_threshold vs the meter's own trailing
-- spike_history_days (>= spike_min_points clean points) AND kWh >= spike_min_multiple x the
-- trailing mean. Only clean intervals (received, no gap spanned, delta known) are used.
-- Consecutive flagged intervals of one meter are merged into one event.

with clean as (
    select
        meter_id,
        feeder_id,
        zone_id,
        interval_start_ts,
        delta_kwh::double as kwh
    from "gridpulse"."main_intermediate"."int_meter_intervals"
    where delta_kwh is not null and gap_intervals = 0
),

stats as (
    select
        *,
        avg(kwh) over w as mean_kwh,
        stddev_samp(kwh) over w as std_kwh,
        count(*) over w as history_points
    from clean
    window w as (
        partition by meter_id
        order by epoch(interval_start_ts)
        range between 2592000 preceding and 1 preceding
    )
),

flagged as (
    select
        *,
        (kwh - mean_kwh) / std_kwh as z_score
    from stats
    where
        history_points >= 96
        and std_kwh > 0
        and (kwh - mean_kwh) / std_kwh > 3.0
        and kwh >= 8 * mean_kwh
),

islands as (
    select
        *,
        epoch(interval_start_ts) / (15 * 60)
        - row_number() over (partition by meter_id order by interval_start_ts) as island
    from flagged
)

select
    'SPIKE' as anomaly_type,
    meter_id,
    feeder_id,
    zone_id,
    min(interval_start_ts) as start_ts,
    max(interval_start_ts) + interval 15 minute as end_ts,
    count(*) as intervals,
    'max_z_score' as metric_name,
    round(max(z_score), 3)::decimal(12, 3) as metric_value,
    3.0::decimal(12, 3) as threshold,
    1 as affected_meters,
    round(max(kwh), 4)::decimal(18, 4) as peak_kwh
from islands

-- US-12 AC1 / NFR-11: per meter-day, Σ hourly kWh = Σ register deltas recomputed directly from
-- staging (independent of int_meter_intervals). Difference must be exactly 0.
with staged as (
    select
        r.meter_id,
        r.interval_date_ist,
        r.register_kwh,
        r.status,
        m.register_max_kwh,
        lag(r.register_kwh) over (partition by r.meter_id order by r.reading_ts) as prev_kwh
    from "gridpulse"."main_staging"."stg_meter__readings" as r
    inner join "gridpulse"."main"."meter_master" as m on r.meter_id = m.meter_id
),

staged_daily as (
    select
        meter_id,
        interval_date_ist,
        coalesce(sum(
            case
                when register_kwh >= prev_kwh then register_kwh - prev_kwh
                when status = 'ROLLOVER' then register_max_kwh - prev_kwh + register_kwh
            end
        ), 0) as staged_kwh
    from staged
    group by meter_id, interval_date_ist
),

hourly_daily as (
    select
        meter_id,
        interval_date_ist,
        sum(consumption_kwh) as hourly_kwh
    from "gridpulse"."main_marts"."fct_consumption_hourly"
    group by meter_id, interval_date_ist
)

select
    h.meter_id,
    h.interval_date_ist,
    h.hourly_kwh,
    s.staged_kwh
from hourly_daily as h
left join staged_daily as s
    on h.meter_id = s.meter_id and h.interval_date_ist = s.interval_date_ist
where h.hourly_kwh <> coalesce(s.staged_kwh, 0)

-- Billing-ready kWh per meter per IST month (FR-10). DECIMAL(18,4), never FLOAT.
-- is_partial_month: the data window does not cover every day of the month (do not bill yet).

select
    date_trunc('month', interval_date_ist)::date as billing_month_ist,
    meter_id,
    feeder_id,
    zone_id,
    sum(consumption_kwh)::decimal(18, 4) as billed_kwh,
    count(*) as days_covered,
    sum(intervals_expected) as intervals_expected,
    sum(intervals_received) as intervals_received,
    sum(gap_intervals) as gap_intervals,
    sum(register_decrease_intervals) as register_decrease_intervals,
    count(*) filter (where quality_flag = 'LOW_COMPLETENESS') as low_completeness_days,
    round(100.0 * sum(intervals_received) / sum(intervals_expected), 2)::decimal(6, 2)
        as completeness_pct,
    count(*) < day(last_day(min(interval_date_ist))) as is_partial_month,
    case
        when sum(register_decrease_intervals) > 0 then 'REGISTER_DECREASE'
        when sum(intervals_received) < sum(intervals_expected) * 0.9
            then 'LOW_COMPLETENESS'
        else 'OK'
    end as quality_flag
from "gridpulse"."main_marts"."fct_consumption_daily"
group by date_trunc('month', interval_date_ist)::date, meter_id, feeder_id, zone_id

-- Daily kWh per feeder with completeness (FR-09, dashboard "feeder consumption" tab).

select
    feeder_id,
    zone_id,
    interval_date_ist,
    sum(consumption_kwh)::decimal(18, 4) as consumption_kwh,
    count(*) as meters,
    count(*) filter (where intervals_received > 0) as meters_reporting,
    count(*) filter (where quality_flag = 'LOW_COMPLETENESS') as low_completeness_meters,
    round(100.0 * sum(intervals_received) / sum(intervals_expected), 2)::decimal(6, 2)
        as completeness_pct
from "gridpulse"."main_marts"."fct_consumption_daily"
group by feeder_id, zone_id, interval_date_ist

-- Completeness % per zone per IST day (dashboard KPI, FR-18 / FR-22).
-- expected = every master meter x 96 slots; silent meters count as missing.

with zones as (
    select distinct
        zone_id,
        zone_name
    from "gridpulse"."main"."feeder_zone"
)

select
    d.interval_date_ist,
    d.zone_id,
    z.zone_name,
    count(*) as meters_in_master,
    count(*) filter (where d.intervals_received > 0) as meters_reporting,
    sum(d.intervals_expected) as intervals_expected,
    sum(d.intervals_received) as intervals_received,
    round(100.0 * sum(d.intervals_received) / sum(d.intervals_expected), 2)::decimal(6, 2)
        as completeness_pct,
    count(*) filter (where d.quality_flag = 'LOW_COMPLETENESS') as low_completeness_meter_days
from "gridpulse"."main_marts"."fct_consumption_daily" as d
inner join zones as z on d.zone_id = z.zone_id
group by d.interval_date_ist, d.zone_id, z.zone_name

-- Daily kWh per zone (FR-09).

with zones as (

-- One row per detected anomaly event: SPIKE, TAMPER, OUTAGE (FR-11..13, dashboard anomaly list).

with unioned as (
    select * from "gridpulse"."main_intermediate"."int_anomalies_spike_detected"
    union all by name
    select * from "gridpulse"."main_intermediate"."int_anomalies_tamper_detected"
    union all by name
    select * from "gridpulse"."main_intermediate"."int_anomalies_outage_detected"
)

select
    md5(
        concat_ws('|', anomaly_type, coalesce(meter_id, ''), feeder_id, start_ts::varchar)
    ) as anomaly_id,
    anomaly_type,
    meter_id,
    feeder_id,
    zone_id,
    start_ts,
    end_ts,
    cast(timezone('Asia/Kolkata', start_ts) as date) as start_date_ist,
    intervals,
    metric_name,
    metric_value,
    threshold,
    affected_meters,
    peak_kwh
from unioned
